padron--1964-anniversary-series.description: Introduced in 1994 to mark Padrón's thirtieth year, this box-pressed Nicaraguan puro is made only from tobacco aged four years, under a sun-grown natural or maduro wrapper. The long rest gives a smooth, complex smoke built on cocoa, dark coffee and earth.

thirds.notes: Smooth, deep earth with baker's cocoa and dark-roast coffee, and a light touch of black pepper.
The cocoa steps back for a creamy, gently sweet coffee; the pepper fades and the finish grows long.
Cocoa returns in force and keeps the sweetness to the end, as the body climbs back to full.

sources.title: Padrón – 1964 Anniversary Series
Cigar Obsession – 1964 Anniversary Maduro Exclusivo review

padron--padron-series.description: The house line Padrón has rolled since 1964: a Nicaraguan puro of sun-grown long filler, rested at least two and a half years and offered in natural or maduro across fifteen sizes, from the small Corticos to the Magnum. It smokes medium to full, opening with pepper before settling into coffee, earth, cedar and a cocoa sweetness.

thirds.notes: A brisk pepper and spice start that soon calms into earth and dark coffee.
The heat recedes; coffee and cream take over, with fresh cedar and cocoa turning gently sweet.
Deep earth comes back with spiced nuts and a warm, woody cedar finish.

sources.title: Padrón – Padrón Series
Cigar Dojo – Padrón Series 2000 Maduro review

padron--1926-serie.description: First released in 2002 for José Orlando Padrón's 75th birthday, the 1926 Serie is a box-pressed Nicaraguan puro made from tobacco aged five years, in sun-grown natural or maduro, each cigar with a numbered band. Smooth for its weight, it moves between espresso, cocoa and earth, with cedar and a quiet pepper on the retrohale.

thirds.notes: Early spice gives way as cocoa and coffee trade places, ending creamy with cedar and light pepper through the nose.
Coffee leads, joined by soft cocoa and earth; the pepper on the retrohale grows a little firmer.
A mocha-like blend of coffee and cocoa over earth, with cedar and pepper lingering to the end.

sources.title: Padrón – 1926 Serie
The Cigar Authority – Padrón 1926 Serie No. 9 Maduro review

padron--family-reserve.description: Once kept for the Padrón family alone, the Family Reserve has been sold since 2008; its numbers mark company or family milestones. The Nicaraguan tobacco rests ten years before blending, under a sun-grown natural or maduro wrapper. It starts strong with pepper over dark chocolate, leather and wood, then turns rounder and softer towards the end.

thirds.notes: Dark chocolate, leather and oak with a dry hay note; a firm black pepper burst calms after the first puffs.
Much the same core, now with an occasional plum-like sweetness and almost no pepper.
The flavours mellow and the strength eases, with a faint trace of pepper on the retrohale.

sources.title: Padrón – Family Reserve
halfwheel – Padrón Family Reserve No. 85 review

padron--damaso.description: Named for Dámaso Padrón, who left the Canary Islands for Cuba in the late 1800s, this 2015 line is Padrón's lighter side: an Ecuadorian Connecticut wrapper over Nicaraguan binder and filler. It smokes mild to medium with toast, hay and soft wood, while the Red Label sizes No. 32 and No. 34 carry a fuller blend.

thirds.notes: Pepper first, then toasted tobacco and a light sweetness as the third closes.
Earth, grassy hay and leather; the grassiness turns woody and a little pepper returns.
Sweet hay and cedar with a faint caramel touch as the earthier notes fade.

sources.title: Padrón – Dámaso Series
Blind Man's Puff – Padrón Dámaso No. 12 review

padron--40th-anniversary.description: Made in 2004 to mark forty years of Padrón, this 6½ x 54 box-pressed torpedo belongs to the 1926 Serie and comes in sun-grown natural or maduro, all Nicaraguan tobacco. It opens smooth around cedar, earth and a light pepper, then gathers coffee, sweet spice and a creamy texture as it climbs to medium-full.

thirds.notes: Smooth and close to mild-medium at first, with cedar, earth and dry cocoa under a white-pepper finish.
Coffee builds beside cedar and cinnamon-like spice, with a creamy, bready softness and some sweet leather.
The coffee deepens towards espresso as the strength rises, staying clean to the nub.

sources.title: Padrón – 1926 Serie (No. 40)
Casas Fumando – Padrón Serie 1926 40 Years Natural review
Cigar Obsession – Padrón 1926 40th Anniversary Natural review

padron--50th-anniversary.description: Padrón's half-century release of 2014: 1,000 humidors of fifty cigars, each a lightly box-pressed 6½ x 52 Nicaraguan puro made from tobacco aged at least ten years, in natural or maduro. It builds from earth, peanut and cocoa to cedar, espresso and raisin sweetness, finishing full with pepper and leather.

thirds.notes: Earth and peanut with leather, cocoa powder and hay, black pepper through the nose and a sweetness starting to build.
Creamy cedar, dark chocolate and bitter espresso, cinnamon on the retrohale and a raisin note growing on the finish.
Raisin sweetness leads, with earth, cedar, leather and nuts as the pepper rises and the strength settles at full.

sources.title: Padrón – 50th Anniversary
halfwheel – Padrón 50th Anniversary Limited Edition Natural review

padron--60th-anniversary.description: Released in 2024 for sixty years of Padrón, this 6½ x 56 perfecto tapers at both head and foot and is only the second perfecto in the company's history. It is made entirely from Nicaraguan tobacco in sun-grown natural or maduro, by one pair of rollers in Estelí, and each cigar rests in its own wooden coffin.

sources.title: Padrón – 60th Anniversary
Cigar Aficionado – Padrón releasing perfecto to celebrate 60th anniversary
The Cigar Authority – Padrón 60th Anniversary
Holt's Clubhouse – Padrón 60th Anniversary review

thirds.notes: In the natural, silky cocoa powder, cedar and walnut come slowly into focus while the tapered head opens up.
As the draw widens, black pepper rings through the nose over molasses and cocoa, with cayenne, nutmeg and cinnamon.
Coffee bean and molasses build, and the last part brings malty cocoa and a frothy, cappuccino-like softness.

padron--80-years.description: Made for José Orlando Padrón's 80th birthday, the 80 Years is a box-pressed 6¾ x 54 perfecto and Padrón's first in that shape, rolled from some of the company's oldest Nicaraguan tobacco in natural or maduro. It moves from coffee and mocha through dark chocolate and nuts to a leather-led close.

thirds.notes: Coffee alternates with mocha and cocoa, the coffee winning out, with nuttiness on the retrohale.
The mocha darkens into chocolate while coffee and nuts carry on and light leather appears.
Leather takes the lead over a lasting coffee finish, with sweetness and nuts drifting in and out.

sources.title: Padrón – 1926 Serie (No. 80)
The Cigar Authority – Padrón 80 Years Maduro review
Cigar Aficionado – Padrón releasing perfecto to celebrate 60th anniversary

padron--padron-black-special-releases.description: Padrón's Black releases honour what would have been José O. Padrón's 97th and 99th birthdays: the PB-97, a 6¾ x 54 figurado, and the broader 6¾ x 60 PB-99, both Nicaraguan puros in sun-grown natural or maduro, in small numbered batches. The PB-97 Maduro opens with heavy pepper before chocolate, coffee and wood come forward.

thirds.notes: A wave of pepper over chocolate, then cinnamon, coffee and wood with a hint of citrus on the finish.
The pepper relents; coffee and sweetness lead over wood, chocolate, musty earth and a bready note.
Pepper and coffee push back to the front and the smoke grows rougher, keeping a sweet finish.

LA Cigar Collective – Padrón Black 97 Maduro
